commits.message: High-pass fixes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.zgr): the pointer shape is terminal state the painter commits, one sent/refused record for it and progress (App's pointerSent/showPointer and setPointerShape's boolean gone); VTE answers VTE(<n>) and a VTE before 0.54 is not asked; askTerminalIdentity returns undefined when the answer changes nothing; refusals decided once per features object handed over; one option shape, a layer without evidence held declared; a multiplexer the env never saw resets the terminal to other; any layer stronger than identified keeps its place; Zellij( pattern; a steady commit allocates nothing; the demo guards its race

Medium-pass fixes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.zgr): the painter remembers what the terminal was actually sent, so a refused change is decided again under new features and nothing is re-sent that already went (featuresChanged and the undefined state are gone); App tracks the pointer shape sent the same way, and its terminalFeatures setter refuses a stopped app as pointerShape does; identifiedBy keeps a declared multiplexer where it was declared; a layer passed in names no evidence and the console holds it as declared; evidence strength is a Record, no indexOf. zellij stays in HIDES_TERMINAL_VERSION: verified it answers XTVERSION itself as Zellij(<version>) in zellij-server/src/panes/grid.rs

Review fixes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.zgr): learned features re-send what the old ones refused; an XTVERSION answer never outweighs declared or confirmed evidence, drops only inferred tmux/zellij/screen layers, never duplicates a layer; an unrecognized answer learns nothing; askTerminalIdentity returns undefined when nothing was learned; Layer carries its own evidence

The terminal identifies itself: askTerminalIdentity asks XTVERSION and raises what the env inferred to identified; tmux answers for itself, so no passthrough-wrapped probe is sent (tmux#5530); painters read features from their console; a replay host answers recorded probe sessions (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.zgr)

Clipboard, pointer and notification chosen by pick over the console's TerminalFeatures (6ch.a28) (#599)

* Clipboard, pointer and notification are chosen by pick over the console's TerminalFeatures: one fact for layers and terminal, passthrough evidence weighed, the route in the send log (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.a28)

* Review: a tmux or screen pane's TERM names no terminal past it; declaring an encoding keeps the inferred terminal; bell and title are pick rows; docs say no policy passes an unconfirmed layer (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.a28)

* Review: a terminal's own notification and progress cannot cross zellij or an editor (OUTER_ONLY); a bare number in OSC 9 is kept off ConEmu's shape (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.a28)

* Review: textOrderOf takes named fields; CLAUDE.md and terminal-identity's header describe the pick tables; one tmux-TERM test over both policies (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.a28)
Resume is pinned over half a second; the last depth rebuild is checked to keep 1 fps (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
One frame per colour depth; pause is pinned at sixty frames a second over a tenth of a second; the rate and frame checks say what they read (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
One writtenOver check: what a window wrote must hold a gallery frame, and a depth rebuild must keep 1 fps (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
The no-color checks require a painted frame, so an empty window cannot pass them (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
The colour-depth and pause playground tests play at one frame a second, so they no longer paint hundreds of unread gallery frames (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
